name: ImageSharpen
description:
Enhances image clarity by applying an unsharp mask filter. 
This technique works by:
1. Creating a blurred copy of the original image
2. Finding edges by comparing differences
3. Enhancing edge contrast where differences are found
*Note:* Despite the name "unsharp mask", this process actually increases sharpness.

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: gain
params.description:
Gain values can be integers or real numbers. The default value is 1.0.
The value determines whether the image is blurred or sharpened:

- if > 0, the image is sharpened
- if = 0, no effect
- if < 0, the image is blurred
